item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial narrated by Michael Jackson
item.description:
Hello fellow audiophiles and lovers of music,

I am looking for a vinyl rip of the 1982 E.T the Extra-Terrestrial audiobook narrated by Michael Jackson in any lossless format.

As a collector and somewhat of an MJ archivist, this inclusion would mean the world to me as I don’t own the physical vinyl myself.

Thank you so much for your time!
